evals.prompt: I just finished a QLoRA fine-tune of Qwen3 4B in Unsloth. Write the code to export it to GGUF as q4_k_m and q8_0 and push both to my Hugging Face account.
evals.query: I just finished a QLoRA fine-tune of Qwen3 4B in Unsloth. Write the code to export it to GGUF as q4_k_m and q8_0 and push both to my Hugging Face account.
evals.expected_output: Python code that loads the trained LoRA with FastLanguageModel.from_pretrained, then exports GGUF with quantization_method q4_k_m and q8_0, pushing to HF with push_to_hub_gguf (ideally a single multi-quant call). Should mention the HF token and that q8_0 is the default.
assertions: Loads the trained LoRA via FastLanguageModel.from_pretrained
Calls save_pretrained_gguf or push_to_hub_gguf
Passes quantization_method including q4_k_m
Passes quantization_method including q8_0 (or notes q8_0 is the default)
Uses push_to_hub_gguf with an HF token argument
Passes quantization_method as a list for a single multi-quant call, or explains that this is faster than separate calls

evals.prompt: Explain the difference between Unsloth dynamic GGUFs and standard imatrix quants, and which one I should pick for a 7B model I want to run in Ollama.
evals.query: Explain the difference between Unsloth dynamic GGUFs and standard imatrix quants, and which one I should pick for a 7B model I want to run in Ollama.
evals.expected_output: Explanation that dynamic GGUFs quantize per-layer with a model-specific scheme plus curated chat-aware imatrix calibration (pure PTQ, no QAT), that standard quants use one global scheme, and that KL divergence (not perplexity) is the right comparison metric. Should recommend a Dynamic 4-bit (UD-Q4_K_XL) for a 7B model and note UD- naming.
assertions: Mentions per-layer / dynamic layer selection (or model-specific quant scheme) for dynamic GGUFs
Mentions imatrix calibration data and that dynamic quants use a curated chat-aware one
States dynamic GGUFs are post-training quantization (no QAT/QAD training on the calibration data)
Names KL divergence (KLD) as the preferred metric over perplexity
Recommends a 4-bit quant (e.g. UD-Q4_K_XL / Q4_K_XL) for the 7B model
Mentions UD- prefixed naming of Unsloth's quants

evals.prompt: Give me a QAT training script for a small model (like Gemma 4 E2B) that ends in a 4-bit model, using Unsloth and TorchAO.
evals.query: Give me a QAT training script for a small model (like Gemma 4 E2B) that ends in a 4-bit model, using Unsloth and TorchAO.
evals.expected_output: A script that loads the model with FastLanguageModel.from_pretrained, adds adapters or full finetuning with qat_scheme='int4', trains with SFTTrainer, runs quantize_(model, QATConfig(step='convert')) after training, and saves a 4-bit model with save_pretrained_torchao. Should include the torchao install pin and note QAT has no extra inference overhead.
assertions: Uses FastLanguageModel.from_pretrained to load the model
Sets qat_scheme (e.g. 'int4') in get_peft_model or from_pretrained
Calls quantize_ with QATConfig(step='convert') after training
Exports the 4-bit model via save_pretrained_torchao (optionally with Int4WeightOnlyConfig)
Includes a torchao installation (e.g. torchao==0.14.0 or the notebook's 0.16.0/0.18.0 pins)
Mentions that QAT recovers accuracy vs naive 4-bit PTQ and/or has no extra inference overhead

evals.prompt: I want to serve my Unsloth fine-tune in vLLM. Show me how to merge the LoRA into the base model and upload it to Hugging Face.
evals.query: I want to serve my Unsloth fine-tune in vLLM. Show me how to merge the LoRA into the base model and upload it to Hugging Face.
evals.expected_output: Code using save_pretrained_merged / push_to_hub_merged with save_method='merged_16bit' (float16) and mentioning 'merged_4bit' (int4) as the smaller alternative, with the HF token. Should note the LoRA-adapter-only fallback.
assertions: Uses save_pretrained_merged and/or push_to_hub_merged
Passes save_method = 'merged_16bit'
Mentions merged_4bit as the int4 alternative
Includes the HF token in the push call
Mentions saving just the LoRA adapters (save_pretrained / push_to_hub) as a fallback
